name: Landhaus Bergfried
beschreibung: Landhaus Bergfried is situated in a quiet hillside location in the Tiroler Ötztal, away from the through roads. The surroundings are characterized by extensive alpine pastures and mountain meadows and an imposing summit panorama. The inn's facilities include rooms in an Alpine country style, a traditional guest parlour, and a spa area for guests. The atmosphere is considered homely and quiet, which is due to the personal management and the location close to nature. The house primarily caters to hikers in summer and skiers in winter, as well as to those seeking relaxation. The in-house kitchen places emphasis on regional products and traditional preparation.
